say.speaker: partner
say.text: Uh, guys? Is that a Slakoth napping right in the middle of the meadow while poachers close in?!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Do not let that drowsy posture fool you. Youngsters like Slakoth start frail, yet harbor tremendous Hidden Potential once trained.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Let's hurry across the grass, Talk to Slakoth to wake him up, and clear out these poachers!
